t: The Hager Sollysta WMPS3PIF 10A Fan Isolator switch provides a safe and reliable method for controlling ventilation units. Its raised slim profile and white plastic finish offer a discreet appearance, while the screwed faceplate ensures a secure fit. Installation is made easier with backed-out captive screws and clear terminal markings. A minimum 25mm back box depth is required.
b: Upward Facing Backed-Out Captive Terminal Screws
